title: Stuut Secures $52.5M Series B Led by Insight Partners to Scale AI Agents for Order-to-Cash
key_facts: Stuut, a New York AI platform for order-to-cash at large enterprises, secured a $52.5 million Series B led by Insight Partners.
Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft's Venture Fund and Activant took part; total funding is $93 million.
The round came ten months after its Series A.
Stuut automates collections, cash application, payments, disputes and deductions, contacting customers by SMS, email and phone.
The company says 81.7% of outbound collections activity runs without human involvement and 95% of incoming payments are matched automatically.
More than 150 customers, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and Verifone; over $3 billion processed.
Growing over 90% quarter over quarter; funds will expand into credit, lending and funds movement.
quote_evidence: Stuut, the New York-based AI platform that runs order-to-cash for large enterprises, has secured a $52.5 million Series B led by Insight Partners, with participation from Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund and Activant.
The company said 81.7% of outbound collections activity now runs without human involvement and 95% of incoming payments are matched automatically.
Growing over 90% quarter over quarter, Stuut will use the funding to meet demand and expand into credit, lending and funds movement.
why_it_matters_hint: AI agents are taking over the chasing and matching of customer payments at large companies.
